shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat — plus paintable glass skylight zones (stackable, grow-light sun), mountain-top rivers with waterfalls, island-aware logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection OR compile-ref. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message on trip. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY (combat, drops) is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- See-below VISION extends through skylight glass (vision + light only; sealed for gameplay).
- All levels are real maps (pocket maps in Find.Maps, tick every game tick). Viewing a level swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir (Impassable) + plateaus AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop (Standable) + AB_Skylight (Standable glass, dontRender).

## ANIMAL FLOW FIX (2026-07-24, user bug report: "animals attracted to basements, never return") — built, UNTESTED
Root cause was TWO deliberate lures with missing/weak return legs:
1. **Pet food trips were one-way** (the big one). EligiblePetForFood (T7 #6) ships a hungry non-pen pet to a linked level's food — but nothing ever routed it back, and each hunger cycle sent more down. FIX: every pet food migration now records pawn id -> home map id (NotePetFoodTrip in Patch_GetFood). New `CrossLevelAnimals.ScanPetReturns` (LevelComp tick, all levels, Due 600t, static-count zero-cost gate) walks fed+idle recorded pets home hop by hop: skips hungry (<0.35), sleeping (LayDown != idle; returns after waking), mental, lorded, AB_UseStairs-busy; drops the record when home, expired (60000t), rope-managed (pen logic owns it), or home map gone. Only pets WE moved are returned — player-arranged pets untouched. Gated on Logistics kill switch but NOT the crossLevelNeeds setting (cleanup must run even after feature off). **Records are SCRIBED** (ABGameComp.ExposeData -> ExposePetTrips, parallel lists + scribedIn-flag handshake against FinalizeInit's static reset) — otherwise a save between meal and walk-home stranded the pet permanently (post-load it eats locally, no new record forms).
2. **Wild escape policy could be starved**. Ambient descent (flavor, cap 4, spacing 12000t) has an escape rule, but it required the animal IDLE at scan moment — an animal camped on basement food stores (eating/sleeping, never hungry, rarely idle) squatted indefinitely. FIX: `WildAnimalMustOff` — a FULL extra linger past due interrupts regardless of job (registers unseen animals so the clock always runs); wired as `(IsIdle && WantsOff) || MustOff` in HostileDescend.ShouldDescendFriendly. Also fixed int-overflow in the linger stagger (`id*977 % base` went negative on large thingIDNumbers -> uint math).
Ambient descent itself is unchanged (deliberate flavor; `crossLevelAnimalWander` setting turns it off entirely).

## BETTER ARCHITECT MENU COMPAT (2026-07-24, user request) — built, UNTESTED
Compat/ABBetterArchitectCompat.cs, detection-gated ([StaticConstructorOnStartup] + ABDetect "ferny.BetterArchitect", zero cost when absent, fail-open warnings). BAM decompiled: its material availability is CURRENT-MAP gated via `Find.CurrentMap.listerThings.ThingsOfDef` in two private methods; both now transpiled (ThingsOfDef -> our existing `ColumnThingsOfDef` from the vanilla stuff-picker patch: local list wins when non-empty, else first linked level's non-empty list):
- **PopulateMaterials** (Floors-tab material list): materials stored on any column level now appear.
- **GetStuffFrom** (sort-value stuff resolver): def source is resourceCounter.AllCountedAmounts (already column-merged by our ResourceCounter postfix); the per-map presence gate is now column-wide.
- **Info-box cost readout**: vanilla DrawPanelReadout reds-out via resourceCounter.GetCount — already column-correct through our merge, no patch needed.
- **Verified non-interactions** (decompiled): BAM's ProcessInput transpiler anchors on MadeFromStuff getter, ours on ThingsOfDef — compose either order; BAM's floors tab bypasses the stuff float menu entirely (shouldSkipFloatMenu + direct SetStuffDef), our picker transpiler simply never runs in that flow.
Note BAM is currently INACTIVE in the user's modlist — compat arms automatically when they enable it.

## PERFORMANCE PASS (2026-07-24, quadruple pass) — complete
Four zero-behavior-change fixes (SkylightSystem.CompFor CWT; SkylightMapComp.AnyWork version-memo; shaft CompGlower cache; LevelSync mesh-flag mask hoist). Everything else audited-and-cleared (TTL caches, version stamps, count gates, elapsed-time Due scheduling, async mask lane, probe budgets, versioned cooldowns). New animal/compat code follows the same rules (count-gated tick scans, Due cadence, bounded dicts).

## PERF-MOD COMPLIANCE AUDIT (2026-07-24) — decompile-verified vs live modlist
PO (Pawn.DrawPos + IsForbidden caches are scope-limited and can't intersect our windows; FasterGetCompReplacement transpiles our GetComponent call sites into its Dictionary<Map,T> cache — reference-keyed, composes with our CWTs; CurCelestialSunGlow per-map ~60t cache harmless vs shaft threshold; UI throttles inherited in lockstep). TPT (synthetic-Invalid throttle bounded by TryAutoAcquire's own cooldown). Dubs Analyzer (profiler only). XML tick mods (structurally can't intersect). RocketMan/Perf Fish/RimThreaded not installed; RimThreaded documented UNSUPPORTED. Invariants documented in code (RenderPatches, Skylights, CrossLevelTurret). Standing rules: idempotent postfixes on cacheable methods; reference-keyed or versioned caches; never assume vanilla call cadence; no tick-exact logic on cacheable getters.

## BATCH D (2026-07-24) — built, compile-green, UNTESTED
### Skylight zones (Systems/Skylights.cs, SkylightDesignators.cs, SkylightWork.cs)
- **UX**: two Designator_Cells in vanilla Zone architect category (XML patch): "Skylight zone" / "Clear skylight zone". Painted on the level you are VIEWING; replaces the slab under your feet. Hidden on maps with no level below + behind `skylights` setting. Painted set = desired state; CellBoolDrawer overlay.
- **Work**: WorkGiver_ABSkylights (Construction) reconciles both directions: AB_BuildSkylight (2200) / AB_RemoveSkylight (1000). Work-only, no materials, Construction XP, Floor reservation. Originals restored on removal.
- **State**: SkylightMapComp per map (scribed). GlobalPaneCount early-out; CompFor CWT-cached; AnyWork version-memoized.
- **Light**: AB_SkylightShaft invisible glower on the lit map per pane; CompGlower (radius 3.5, overlight 2.1) gated via IThingGlower: celestial sun >= 0.4 AND pane chain open. Rare-tick; glower comp cached. KNOWN GAP: ignores weather/eclipse dimming.
- **Rendering**: glass = dontRender terrain + pale tint + frame hairlines; below-band draws for level 0 gated on AnyPanes; two-deep stack at StackedDrop(420); ABBelowThings prints at air OR glass; LevelSync mirror extended basement->surface. KNOWN GAP: sky->basement is printed content only.
- **Safety nets**: SetTerrain postfix dissolves panes; rooftop sync reverts glass->air on roof loss; load-time shaft validation; CellVisibleFromAbove treats glass as visible.
### Mountain rivers + waterfalls (GenStep_ABSkyRivers.cs, Waterfalls.cs)
- Genstep AB_SkyRivers (order 205, `mountainRivers` setting): carve rock over ground-map river cells under sky mass; copy exact water terrain; clone riverGraph + straight-copy flowMap; WaterInfo.SetTextures — pixel-exact vanilla flow.
- Waterfalls: lip cells at air borders; direction from waterInfo dot edge normal; two-frame foam + falling sheet + WaterSplash + pitched rain-loop sustainer (root-lip-only voice, 250t recheck); Thing_ABWaterfallBase mist+rumble below. Fails soft.
- KNOWN GAPS: no retrofit of old sky levels; wide rivers correctly no-op.

## PARITY BATCH A — USER-VERIFIED (formation goto, one-step reinstall, stair forbid door parity)
## PARITY BATCH B — built, verification pending (meditation foci, pens, cell casts, ritual prisoners+animals)
## PARITY BATCH C — built, verification pending w/ companions (airship rooftops, sky visitors, Hospitality roaming, stranded-neutral sweep)
## FOOD OPTIMALITY — built (sub-meal contest vs linked levels w/ real travel cost; starving eat local; single-hop). Pet branch now records return trips (see ANIMAL FLOW FIX).
## LOGISTICS — island rework + RELAY + URGENT unchanged. AREAS/ZONES unchanged. COMBAT (Model B) unchanged. SETTINGS — seven tabs (+skylights, mountainRivers, skyVisitorArrivals, hospitalityRoaming).

## Test plan (current)
- **Animal flow verify (isolated)**: pet + basement food stockpile -> pet descends when hungry upstairs, eats, walks back up once idle; save/load mid-trip -> still returns; wild animal in basement past linger -> leaves even while eating/sleeping; ambient descent still capped/rare.
- **Better Architect verify (non-isolated or companion ferny.BetterArchitect)**: floors tab material list shows surface-stored materials while viewing sky level; stuff sort values resolve; floors direct-placement (no stuff menu) still works with column stuff picker present.
- Batch B verify (isolated): anima meditation pull, cross-level take-to-pen, cell-cast below, ritual gathers, berries-vs-fridge upgrade.
- Batch D verify (isolated, river mountain tile): skylight paint/build/restore/dissolve paths; two-deep stack; rivers + waterfalls + flow direction.
- Batch C verify (companionMods: Orion.Hospitality, joeownage.automatic.airships).
- Perf-mod smoke (non-isolated): below view + designations with PO live; turret cross-fire under TPT throttle.
- Older stack: relay/urgent with Allow Tool, BUG1 neutral CE retest, CE-absent palette run, translation audit, soak, publishing.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE. Biomes! Caverns. Alpha Biomes. BM + MO. Odyssey + VLE. Misc. Robots + Robots++. Hauler's Dream + PUAH. Allow Tool. Ancient urban ruins. CE. Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF. Medieval Trader Airships (+legacy), Hospitality (Continued). **Better Architect Menu (transpile compat, detection-gated)**. Performance Optimizer + Dubs Performance Analyzer + Turret Performance Tweaks (decompile-audited). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-24 (8th pass): Batches A+forbid verified; B + C built; food fix built; Batch D built; perf pass + perf-mod audit complete; **animal flow fix (pet returns scribed + wild hard-overdue escape) and Better Architect Menu compat built compile-green**. Next: animal-flow + Batch B+D test (isolated), Batch C + BAM with companion mods.
